def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps2(g,bg)
    groups={}
    for comp in cs:

    pairs=[v for v in groups.values() if len(v)>1]
    if not pairs: return g
    pair=max(pairs,key=lambda v:v[0][1])
    cols={c for c,_,_,_ in pair}
    if 0 in cols:
        sc=Counter(c for c,_,_,_ in cs if c not in cols)
        new=min(sc, key=lambda c:(sc[c],c)) if sc else 0
    else:
        new=0
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
